description: A2-Servitude relative au passage des conduites souterraines d'irrigation is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. Category A2 easements relate to easements of underground irrigation pipes: For the benefit of public authorities and their concessionaires and for the benefit of public establishments, an servitude conferring on them the right to establish permanently, under the most rational and least harmful conditions to the present and future exploitation, with a view to irrigation ... Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Utility easement type A2 relating to the passage of underground irrigation pipes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
